item.title: Anthropic 启动上市路演，拟以每股 70 至 78 美元发行
item.guid: Anthropic-启动上市路演，拟以每股-70-至-78-美元发行
item.description:
Anthropic announced the launch of its initial public offering (IPO) roadshow, planning to list on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT". A revised prospectus submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 10 shows the offering price is expected to be between $70 and $78 per share. Anthropic 宣布启动首次公开募股路演，拟在纳斯达克以「ANT」为股票代码上市。11 月 10 日提交给美国证券交易委员会的修订招股书显示，发行价预计介于每股 70 美元与 78 美元之间。

Based on fully diluted equity, Anthropic's maximum valuation is approximately $1.4 trillion; excluding potential shares such as options and restricted stock, the valuation is about $1 trillion, nearly half of the previously rumored $2 trillion IPO target. 按照完全稀释后的股本计算，Anthropic 最高估值约为 1.4 万亿美元；若不计入期权、限制性股票等潜在股份，估值则约为 1 万亿美元，较此前市场传出的 2 万亿美元 IPO 目标低近一半。

This offering proposes to issue 825 million Class A common shares, of which approximately 801 million shares will be newly issued by Anthropic, and approximately 23.65 million shares will be sold by existing shareholders. Proceeds from the sale of existing shares will go to the respective shareholders. Underwriters also have the option to purchase up to an additional 124 million shares from Anthropic within 30 days. 本次拟发行 8.25 亿股 A 类普通股，其中约 8.01 亿股由 Anthropic 新发，约 2365 万股由现有股东出售。出售旧股所得归相关股东。承销商还可在 30 天内向 Anthropic 额外购买最多约 1.24 亿股。

The prospectus also lists a private placement accompanying the IPO: Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft, and companies under TSMC will collectively subscribe to $26 billion worth of Class N common shares at the same per-share offering price after the IPO is completed and agreed-upon conditions are met. 招股书还列出一笔与 IPO 配套的私募：谷歌、英伟达、AMD、博通、美光、微软和台积电旗下公司将在 IPO 完成后、满足约定条件时，按相同的每股发行价合计认购 260 亿美元的 N 类普通股。

item.title: 华为小折叠电脑 MateBook Fold S 亮相，11 月 14 日开启预订
item.guid: 华为小折叠电脑-MateBook-Fold-S-亮相，11-月-14-日开启预订
item.description:
Huawei has unveiled the appearance and pre-order schedule for its HarmonyOS foldable PC, the MateBook Fold S. The new device will be available in Cloud Sea Blue, Sky White, and Phantom Night Black, and features a screen called "Live Small Square Screen" on its outer body. 华为公布了鸿蒙折叠屏电脑 MateBook Fold S 的外观和预订时间。新机提供云海蓝、天际白和幻夜黑三种配色，机身外侧配有一块名为「Live 小方屏」的屏幕。

Huawei Consumer Business Group's warm-up video used an envelope to demonstrate the device's folded volume. Pre-orders for the new device will begin on November 14 at 10:08 AM, and Huawei is also inviting consumers to experience it in stores. 华为终端的预热视频用信封展示了机器折叠后的体积。新机将于 11 月 14 日 10:08 开启预订，华为同时邀请消费者到店体验。

item.title: Google 开放最强 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Carbon
item.guid: Google-开放最强-AI-模型-Gemini-4-Carbon
item.description:
Google announced the official release of its next-generation AI model, Gemini 4 Carbon, to developers, businesses, researchers, and general users. Previously, the model was launched on October 28 and was initially only available to some cybersecurity defense personnel through the Fairwind program. Google 宣布，正式向开发者、企业、科研人员及普通用户开放新一代 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Carbon。此前，该模型于 10 月 28 日发布，最初仅通过 Fairwind 计划向部分网络安全防御人员开放。

In third-party workflow benchmarks, Google states that Carbon ranked first in all three tests: CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity WANDR, and Zapier AutomationBench, with per-task costs more than 2 times lower than the next best-performing external models. 在第三方工作流基准测试中，Google 称 Carbon 在 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity WANDR 和 Zapier AutomationBench 三项测试中均排名第一，单项任务成本比表现次优的外部模型低 2 倍以上。

Currently, developers and businesses can use Carbon through Google AI Studio's Gemini API (paid plan) and Gemini for Business. General users need to subscribe to Google AI Ultra to experience it in the Gemini App and Google Search's AI Mode. 目前，开发者和企业可以通过 Google AI Studio 的 Gemini API（付费套餐）及 Gemini for Business 使用 Carbon。普通用户则需要订阅 Google AI Ultra，才能在 Gemini App 和 Google 搜索的 AI Mode 中体验。

Google Antigravity has also opened up model access to Google AI Ultra users. Google Antigravity 也向 Google AI Ultra 用户开放了模型使用权限。

Regarding pricing, Carbon currently uses the same launch prices as Argon: $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. The promotional period will end on November 30, after which prices will be adjusted to $4 and $20 respectively. 价格方面，Carbon 目前采用与 Argon 相同的首发价格，每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元。优惠期将于 11 月 30 日结束，之后价格将分别调整至 4 美元和 20 美元。

item.title: 京东被曝内测免费短剧，计划让观众购买剧中同款
item.guid: 京东被曝内测免费短剧，计划让观众购买剧中同款
item.description:
According to a report by "Du Jia," JD.com is internally testing a free short-drama product called "JD Drama Benefits Club." According to the product description, viewers can receive benefits and discounts while watching dramas, and can also purchase in-drama items shipped by JD.com. "Du Jia" experienced the drama-watching and replay functions in the internal test version, but no shopping entrance was visible at the time. 据《读佳》报道，京东正在内测一款名为「京东追剧福利社」的免费短剧产品。按产品介绍，观众看剧可领福利和优惠，也可购买由京东发货的剧中同款。《读佳》在内测版本中体验了刷剧和回看功能，当时未见购物入口。

The internal test page recommends short dramas by genres such as urban and suspense. Viewers can swipe up and down to switch, or enter the series page via "Watch Full Series". The product also offers favorites, watch history, and speed playback, making it convenient to continue watching previously viewed short dramas. 内测页面按都市、悬疑等题材推荐短剧，观众可上下滑动切换，也可通过「看全集」进入剧集页面。产品还提供收藏、观看历史和倍速播放，方便接着看此前刷到的短剧。

item.title: 李斌：蔚来 ES9 将迎来第 4 万辆交付
item.guid: 李斌：蔚来-ES9-将迎来第-4-万辆交付
item.description:
William Li, founder and CEO of Nio, announced the latest sales progress of two flagship SUVs on November 10. According to Phoenix New Media Technology, based on Li's disclosure, the ES9 ranked first in sales in the 500,000-level pure electric vehicle market for the fifth consecutive month in October this year, and is about to welcome its 40,000th delivery. The new ES8 also continued to lead the 400,000-level vehicle market in the same month. 蔚来创始人、CEO 李斌 11 月 10 日公布两款旗舰 SUV 的最新销售进展。据凤凰网科技报道，按李斌披露的口径，ES9 今年 10 月连续第五个月位居 50 万级纯电车型市场销量首位，即将迎来第 4 万辆交付。全新 ES8 同月也继续领跑 40 万级车型市场。

Nio's previous announcement showed that the ES9 began deliveries on May 28, and the 30,000th unit was delivered on September 23. Nio Group delivered a total of 34,246 new vehicles in October, of which the Nio brand delivered 18,125 units. 蔚来此前公告显示，ES9 于 5 月 28 日开启交付，9 月 23 日交付第 3 万辆。蔚来集团 10 月共交付 34,246 辆新车，其中蔚来品牌交付 18,125 辆。

item.title: 董明珠谈格力业绩下滑：铜价上涨，格力将继续用铜
item.guid: 董明珠谈格力业绩下滑：铜价上涨，格力将继续用铜
item.description:
Dong Mingzhu, Chairperson of Gree Electric Appliances, discussed the decline in performance on November 4 at Tmall's "Life Proposal Bureau". According to the conversation compiled by China Household Appliance Network, Dong Mingzhu listed the rise in copper prices as one of the reasons. She said that Gree would continue to use copper and stated that the long-term operational reliability of air conditioners would be considered when selecting materials. 格力电器董事长董明珠 11 月 4 日在天猫《生活提案局》谈及业绩下滑。据中国家电网整理的对谈，董明珠把铜价上涨列为原因之一。她说，格力会继续使用铜，并表示选择用料时会考虑空调长期运行的可靠性。

Gree's Q3 report explained the quarterly performance decline as a year-on-year decrease in its consumer electronics business. Dong Mingzhu also mentioned in the same conversation that Gree plans to showcase a new home appliance product emphasizing appearance and patented design before the end of the year, and discussed the idea of a limited release. 格力三季报对当季业绩下滑的解释是消费电器业务同比下降。董明珠在同场对谈还提到，格力计划在年底前展示一款强调外观和专利设计的家电新品，并谈到限量推出的设想。

item.title: 台积电 10 月营收创今年单月新高，同比增长近六成
item.guid: 台积电-10-月营收创今年单月新高，同比增长近六成
item.description:
TSMC announced its consolidated net revenue for October was NT$586.89 billion, a year-on-year increase of 59.7%. The year-on-year increase in September was 54.6%, and October's revenue also exceeded the highest single-month value for this year, set in August. 台积电公布 10 月合并净营收为 5868.9 亿新台币，同比增长 59.7%。9 月同比增幅为 54.6%，10 月营收也超过了此前 8 月创下的今年单月最高值。

In the first 10 months of this year, TSMC's consolidated net revenue totaled NT$4.485617 trillion, a year-on-year increase of 43.3%. 今年前 10 个月，台积电合并净营收合计 4.485617 万亿新台币，同比增长 43.3%。

item.title: 阿里巴巴拟分拆平头哥，芯片子公司已向港交所递表
item.guid: 阿里巴巴拟分拆平头哥，芯片子公司已向港交所递表
item.description:
Alibaba announced on November 10 its intention to spin off its wholly-owned chip subsidiary, Pingtouge, for a separate listing on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The HKEX has confirmed that Alibaba can proceed with the spin-off, and Pingtouge submitted its listing application confidentially on September 11. 阿里巴巴 11 月 10 日公告，拟分拆全资芯片子公司平头哥，让其在港交所主板独立上市。港交所已确认阿里可以推进分拆，平头哥于 9 月 11 日以保密方式递交上市申请。

The scheme listed in the announcement is a global offering of H-shares, including a public offering in Hong Kong and a placement to institutional and professional investors. Pingtouge provides chips and system-level computing solutions for data centers. Alibaba stated that an independent listing would help Pingtouge directly access equity and debt markets. The spin-off still requires approval from the HKEX Listing Committee and completion of filing with the China Securities Regulatory Commission. 公告列出的方案是全球发售 H 股，包括香港公开发售，以及向机构和专业投资者配售。平头哥为数据中心提供芯片与系统级计算方案。阿里称，独立上市有助于平头哥直接进入股权和债务市场。分拆仍须取得港交所上市委员会批准，并完成中国证监会备案。

item.title: 奥迪与上汽合作项目 CEO 称，AUDI 未来三年将推三款新车
item.guid: 奥迪与上汽合作项目-CEO-称，AUDI-未来三年将推三款新车
item.description:
Alexander Seitz, CEO of the Audi-SAIC strategic cooperation project, told Yicai that the AUDI letter-mark brand will launch three new cars in the next three years, and the plan has entered the execution phase. When asked about exporting to Europe, he stated that the relevant models are developed for Chinese consumers, and the core task for the next few years remains the Chinese market. 奥迪与上汽战略合作项目 CEO 舒睿泽向第一财经表示，AUDI 字母标品牌未来三年将推出三款新车，规划已进入执行阶段。谈及是否出口欧洲，他表示，相关车型面向中国消费者开发，未来几年的核心任务仍是中国市场。

According to Audi's previously announced plan, the Audi Innovation Technology Center in Shanghai is responsible for development from vehicle concept to mass production delivery. Audi and SAIC will jointly develop four new cars based on the second-generation intelligent digital platform, with the first model planned for launch in 2028. Existing AUDI products include the E5 Sportback and E7X. 按照奥迪此前公布的规划，上海的奥迪创新技术中心负责从整车概念到量产交付的开发。奥迪与上汽将基于第二代智能数字平台联合开发四款新车，首款计划于 2028 年推出。AUDI 现有产品包括 E5 Sportback 和 E7X。

item.title: Oura 拟以 6.25 亿美元收购 Counsel Health，将医生服务接入健康数据
item.guid: Oura-拟以-6.25-亿美元收购-Counsel-Health，将医生服务接入健康数据
item.description:
Smart ring manufacturer Oura announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire Counsel Health for a cash consideration of $625 million, with purchase price adjustment clauses, and the transaction is expected to close by the end of this year. 智能戒指厂商 Oura 宣布签署收购 Counsel Health 的最终协议，现金对价为 6.25 亿美元，并设有购买价格调整条款，预计在今年年底前完成交易。

Counsel combines medical AI with its own team of doctors. Users can consult AI within the Oura App based on physiological data recorded by the ring, and if necessary, be referred to a doctor for diagnosis, prescription, or referral services. Both parties plan to continue expanding prevention, acute illness, and specialty and chronic disease management; Counsel will also continue to serve enterprise partners outside of Oura. Counsel 将医疗 AI 与自有医生团队结合。用户可在 Oura App 内根据戒指记录的生理数据向 AI 咨询，必要时转接医生，获得诊断、处方或转诊服务。双方计划继续扩展预防、急性病及专科和慢性病管理；Counsel 也会继续服务 Oura 之外的企业合作伙伴。

Oura also disclosed preliminary, unaudited results: revenue for the fourth fiscal quarter ending September 30 was $533 million, a year-on-year increase of 153%; fiscal year 2026 revenue is approximately $1.75 billion, a year-on-year increase of 92%. Adjusted EBITDA for the fourth fiscal quarter was $87 million, with a profit margin of 16%. The company stated that its existing membership has exceeded 6 million people. Oura 同时披露初步、未经审计的业绩：截至 9 月 30 日的第四财季营收为 5.33 亿美元，同比增长 153%；2026 财年营收约 17.5 亿美元，同比增长 92%。第四财季经调整 EBITDA 为 8700 万美元，利润率为 16%。公司称现有会员已超过 600 万人。

item.title: 💡 派拉蒙天舞 CEO：AI 工具或让片商更敢为新人导演下注
item.guid: 💡-派拉蒙天舞-CEO：AI-工具或让片商更敢为新人导演下注
item.description:
In Paramount Skydance's latest earnings call, CEO David Ellison stated that AI tools can help reduce film production costs, making studios more willing to take risks on new directors and original stories. 在派拉蒙天舞最新一场财报电话会上，首席执行官大卫·埃里森表示，AI 工具可以帮助降低电影制作成本，让片商更愿意为新人导演和原创故事承担风险。

Ellison cited James Cameron's early film "The Terminator" as an example. He believes that if the same shots were remade one by one today, the production cost would be much higher than it was then. For an original film directed by a newcomer and not yet supported by big stars, it's difficult for studios to bet on such a budget. If AI tools can bring the budget down to a more acceptable level, similar projects might be easier to greenlight. 埃里森以詹姆斯·卡梅隆早期拍摄的《终结者》为例。他认为，今天按同样的镜头逐一重拍，制作成本会比当时高得多。面对一部由新人执导、尚未有大明星撑场的原创电影，片商很难按这样的预算押注。AI 工具如果能让预算降到更容易接受的水平，类似项目就可能更容易开拍。

He also compared AI to computer special effects and digital compositing from the early 1990s. "Jurassic Park" and "Terminator 2" are two examples he used to illustrate how production tools broaden cinematic storytelling. In the same earnings call, Ellison defined AI's role as a tool for creators. 他还把 AI 与上世纪 90 年代初的电脑特效和数字合成相比。《侏罗纪公园》和《终结者 2》是他用来说明制作工具如何拓宽电影叙事的两个例子。在同一场电话会上，埃里森将 AI 的角色界定为供创作者使用的工具。

The same Q&A also touched on how AI will change the way audiences discover content. Ellison focused streaming's utility on personalized recommendations, content discovery, and user retention. He also believes that even as production tools become more widespread, stories polished by creators and mature series IPs still hold value. 同一场问答也涉及 AI 会怎样改变观众寻找内容的方式。埃里森把流媒体的用途落在个性化推荐、内容发现和用户留存。他同时认为，即使制作工具越来越普及，由创作者主导打磨的故事和成熟的系列 IP 仍有价值。

item.title: 宝马新世代 iX3 本月开启交付，i3 将在广州车展上市
item.guid: 宝马新世代-iX3-本月开启交付，i3-将在广州车展上市
item.description:
BMW announced the launch arrangements for two new-generation pure electric models in China. The new-generation BMW iX3 will be officially launched on November 25, and customers who have pre-ordered can convert to a firm order, with vehicles to be delivered in succession. The new-generation BMW i3 is scheduled to be launched and open for orders at the Guangzhou Auto Show on November 27. 宝马公布两款新世代纯电车型在中国的上市安排。新世代 BMW iX3 将于 11 月 25 日正式上市，已预订的客户可转为大定，车辆也将陆续交付。新世代 BMW i3 则定于 11 月 27 日在广州车展上市并开启订购。

The new-generation i3 is the first sedan on BMW's new-generation platform, adopting a nationwide unified price. After its launch, customers can place firm orders directly, with deliveries planned to commence in the first quarter of 2027. The new car features the sixth-generation BMW eDrive electric drive, panoramic iDrive, and a driving assistance system jointly developed by BMW and Momenta. 新世代 i3 是宝马新世代平台的首款轿车，采用全国统一价，上市后可直接下大定，计划于 2027 年第一季度陆续交付。新车搭载第六代 BMW eDrive 电驱、全景 iDrive，以及宝马与 Momenta 联合开发的驾驶辅助系统。

BMW will also debut the dual-texture custom paint finish of the BMW 7 Series to the Chinese public at the auto show, combining high-gloss and matte surfaces on the same body. The new generation MINI COUNTRYMAN will also make its China debut at the event. 宝马还将在车展上首次向中国公众展示 BMW 7 系的双质感定制涂装，同一车身结合高光和哑光两种表面。新一代 MINI COUNTRYMAN 也将在现场迎来中国首秀。

item.title: 曝苹果开发「Harbor」，可将多台 Mac 的统一内存用于本地 AI 推理
item.guid: 曝苹果开发「Harbor」，可将多台-Mac-的统一内存用于本地-AI-推理
item.description:
Developer Aaron Perris discovered that Apple is developing a Mac app called Harbor, currently in private preview under the Claris brand, with the goal of allowing users to run open-weight models directly on Apple Silicon Macs. 开发者 Aaron Perris 发现，苹果正在开发名为 Harbor 的 Mac 应用，目前以 Claris 品牌进行私人预览，目标是让用户直接在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上运行开放权重模型。

The introduction published by Perris shows that Harbor can browse, download, and load models within the app; after two or more Thunderbolt 5-enabled Macs are connected, the app can automatically identify devices and form a cluster, pooling unified memory as inference resources to run models exceeding single-machine capacity or handle more concurrent requests. Perris 公布的介绍显示，Harbor 可在应用内浏览、下载和加载模型；两台或更多支持 Thunderbolt 5 的 Mac 连接后，应用可自动识别设备并组建集群，将统一内存汇集为推理资源，用于运行超出单机容量的模型，或承载更多并发请求。

This introduction emphasizes local processing: data remains on the user's own hardware, and model management and cluster setup are handled by the application. 9to5Mac states that the app's positioning is to lower the barrier to setting up private AI inference servers. 这份介绍强调本地处理：数据保留在用户自己的硬件上，模型管理和集群设置由应用完成。9to5Mac 称，这款应用的定位是降低搭建私人 AI 推理服务器的门槛。

item.title: 大晓机器人在酒店演示从客房取衣到洗烘送回
item.guid: 大晓机器人在酒店演示从客房取衣到洗烘送回
item.description:
Daxiao Robotics demonstrated a set of robotic workflows in a hotel laundry scenario. Robots retrieve clothes from guest rooms, pass through corridors into the laundry area, operate washing machines and dryers, and finally load clothes into baskets and return them to guest rooms. 大晓机器人展示了酒店洗衣场景中的一套机器人工作流程。机器人到客房取衣，穿过走廊进入洗衣区，操作洗衣机和烘干机，最后把衣物装篮送回客房。

The team first used multi-view photos of guest rooms, corridors, elevators, and laundry rooms to reconstruct the training environment, incorporating clothes, laundry baskets, and equipment into a 3D scene that can simulate contact and collision. On-site, a general model is responsible for exploring task approaches, and verified actions are turned into reusable skills, which are then called by robots according to orders. 团队先用客房、走廊、电梯和洗衣房的多视角照片重建训练环境，把衣物、衣篮和设备纳入可模拟接触与碰撞的三维场景。到了现场，通用模型负责探索任务做法，经过验证的动作被做成可复用技能，再由机器人按订单调用。

Retrieving clothes from a dryer was one of the separate tests. The team conducted 165 rounds of real machine experiments over approximately 57 hours, adjusting grasping angles and lifting heights based on video and measurement data. Daxiao stated that in the jeans retrieval test, the proportion of clothes remaining in the drum decreased from an average of 48% to 32%. 烘干机取衣是其中一项单独测试。团队用约 57 小时进行了 165 轮真机实验，根据录像和测量数据调整抓取角度与抬起高度。大晓称，在牛仔裤取衣测试中，留在筒内的衣物比例从平均 48% 降至 32%。

item.title: 小鹏汇天带「陆地航母」亮相里斯本，展示可分离飞行器
item.guid: 小鹏汇天带「陆地航母」亮相里斯本，展示可分离飞行器
item.description:
He Xiaopeng, founder of XPeng AeroHT, showcased the "Land Aircraft Carrier" modular flying car at the opening session of Web Summit in Lisbon. This product consists of a six-wheeled ground vehicle and a retractable aircraft, which can be used separately from the ground vehicle for personal low-altitude flight. 小鹏汇天创始人赵德力在里斯本 Web Summit 开幕环节展示了分体式飞行汽车「陆地航母」。这款产品由六轮陆行体和可收纳的飞行器组成，飞行器可与地面车辆分开使用，面向个人低空飞行。

According to Phoenix New Media Technology, Zhao Deli predicts that the flying car industry will enter a period of rapid development in the next decade, with application scenarios expanding from personal flight experiences to intercity transportation. XPeng AeroHT is also planning the A868 for multi-person and intercity travel, adopting a full-tilt hybrid power solution and developed with a six-seat layout. 据凤凰网科技报道，赵德力预计，未来十年飞行汽车产业会进入高速发展期，应用场景会从个人飞行体验扩展至城际交通。小鹏汇天还在规划面向多人和城际出行的 A868，采用全倾转混合动力方案，按六座布局开发。

item.title: Blender 5.3 上线，可直接导入和渲染三维高斯泼溅
item.guid: Blender-5.3-上线，可直接导入和渲染三维高斯泼溅
item.description:
The official installation package for the open-source 3D creation software Blender 5.3 is now available. The new version adds preliminary support for 3D Gaussian Splatting, allowing users to process 3D scenes reconstructed from photos within Blender and use them with other scene objects. 开源三维创作软件 Blender 5.3 的正式安装包已上线。新版本加入对三维高斯泼溅的初步支持，可以在 Blender 里处理用照片重建的三维场景，并把它们与其他场景对象一起使用。

The new version can import PLY and SPZ files, and also load Gaussian Splatting from USD scenes. When importing PLY files, Blender will determine if it is Gaussian Splatting based on geometric data and attributes. The imported data is carried as a point cloud, which can be adjusted with geometry nodes and rendered in Workbench, EEVEE, and Cycles. 新版可导入 PLY、SPZ 文件，也能从 USD 场景载入高斯泼溅。导入 PLY 文件时，Blender 会根据几何数据和属性判断它是否为高斯泼溅。导入后的数据以点云承载，可用几何节点调整，并在 Workbench、EEVEE 和 Cycles 中渲染。

item.title: 蚂蚁灵波开源触觉模型，让机器人的「手感」跨硬件复用
item.guid: 蚂蚁灵波开源触觉模型，让机器人的「手感」跨硬件复用
item.description:
Ant Group's Lingbo has open-sourced LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model for dexterous robot manipulation, simultaneously releasing model weights, code, and a technical report. The model covers three types of sensors: piezoresistive, magnetic tactile, and visuo-tactile, converting contact signals collected by different hardware into a unified tactile representation for use by robot control models. 蚂蚁灵波开源了面向机器人灵巧操作的触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch，同步发布模型权重、代码和技术报告。模型覆盖压阻、磁触觉和视触觉三类传感器，把不同硬件采集的接触信号转换成统一的触觉表征，供机器人的控制模型使用。

The team used 4983 hours of tactile records for pre-training, with approximately 1.33 billion frames of data. Across 26 real-world tasks with two dexterous hands, the team compared the performance of the original control model, the model with raw tactile signals, and the model integrated with LingBot-Touch features, testing each task 20 times. The project page demonstrates real-machine examples of robots unlocking with a key, squeezing toothpaste with pressure, and sealing bags along the opening. 团队用 4983 小时的触觉记录做预训练，数据约有 13.3 亿帧。在两款灵巧手的 26 项真实任务上，团队分别比较了原始控制模型、加入原始触觉信号和接入 LingBot-Touch 特征的表现，每项任务测试 20 次。项目页展示了机器人用钥匙开锁、按压力挤牙膏和沿封口压合密封袋的实机演示。

item.title: OPPO Watch 5 方表开放预约，11 月 16 日发布
item.guid: OPPO-Watch-5-方表开放预约，11-月-16-日发布
item.description:
OPPO Watch 5 is now available for pre-order on the official store and will be released on November 16th at 19:00. OPPO refers to it as a "thin and light square watch," with the new product featuring a rounded square dial and a knob on the right side. OPPO Watch 5 已在官方商城开启预约，将于 11 月 16 日 19:00 发布。OPPO 将它称为「轻薄小方表」，新品采用圆角方形表盘，右侧有一枚旋钮。

The official store lists five color options: Fantasy Purple, Moonlight White, Starlight Black, Fairy Green, and Wish Orange. The Watch 5 will be launched alongside the Reno17 series phones and the Pad Air6 tablet. 官方商城列出奇遇紫、月光白、星耀黑、仙踪绿和心愿橙五款配色。Watch 5 将与 Reno17 系列手机及 Pad Air6 平板同场发布。

item.title: 波士顿动力给 Atlas 装上滑板车轮，实机完成 360 度跳转
item.guid: 波士顿动力给-Atlas-装上滑板车轮，实机完成-360-度跳转
item.description:
Boston Dynamics announced wheeled experiments with its humanoid robot Atlas. Engineers used custom adapters to attach off-the-shelf scooter wheels to Atlas's existing ankle actuators. With the wheels attached, the robot had to continuously operate with a load during starting, turning, and stopping, allowing the team to test the coordination between the motors and the whole-body control strategy. 波士顿动力公布了人形机器人 Atlas 的轮式实验。工程师用定制转接件，把现成的滑板车轮装到 Atlas 原有的踝关节执行器上。装上轮子后，机器人要在起步、转弯和刹停时持续带着负载运转，团队借此测试电机与全身控制策略的配合。

The 360-degree jump in the video came from a human motion capture sequence. The control strategy learned to track this motion in simulation and completed the jump on its first real-machine attempt. When practicing side shifts, the strategy also learned to roll with the wheels through a motion that originally required foot sliding. Boston Dynamics stated that the experimental findings have begun to be applied to standard Atlas configurations. 视频里的 360 度跳转来自一段真人动作捕捉。控制策略在模拟中学习追踪这段动作，第一次上实机就完成了跳转。练习侧移时，策略还学会用车轮滚过原本需要脚底滑动的一段动作。波士顿动力称，实验所得已开始用于标准配置的 Atlas。

item.title: MiniMax 开放 H3-Image 权重，可直接生成 4096 × 4096 图像
item.guid: MiniMax-开放-H3-Image-权重，可直接生成-4096-×-4096-图像
item.description:
MiniMax released its image model H3-Image on November 10th, with open weights on Hugging Face. The model supports generating images from text and can also edit using one or more reference images. MiniMax stated that under its published test conditions, the model can generate a 4096 × 4096 pixel image in approximately 10 seconds. MiniMax 11 月 10 日发布图像模型 H3-Image，并在 Hugging Face 开放权重。模型支持根据文字生成图像，也能用一张或多张参考图做编辑。MiniMax 称，在其公布的测试条件下，模型约 10 秒可生成一张 4096 × 4096 像素的图像。

MiniMax also provided local deployment documentation, listing inference frameworks such as SGLang, vLLM, Diffusers, and ComfyUI. The official model card shows a comparison of local generation and API results, including editing examples like removing a person's headphones and adjusting their pose based on a reference image. MiniMax 同时给出了本地部署文档，列出 SGLang、vLLM、Diffusers 和 ComfyUI 等推理框架。官方模型卡展示了本地生成与 API 结果的对照，其中包括按参考图去掉人物耳机并调整动作的编辑示例。

item.title: Adobe 更新 Photoshop 和 Premiere，修图可连同倒影一起移除
item.guid: Adobe-更新-Photoshop-和-Premiere，修图可连同倒影一起移除
item.description:
Adobe released Creative Cloud updates at the MAX conference on November 10th. Photoshop's Remove tool can identify footprints, reflections, and shadows related to the target, handling these traces when removing the main subject. The new Relight feature can add light to an image and adjust the light source's position, color, and brightness. Adobe 在 11 月 10 日的 MAX 大会上发布 Creative Cloud 更新。Photoshop 的移除工具可识别与目标相关的脚印、倒影和阴影，移除主体时一并处理这些痕迹。新增的 Relight 可以给画面加光，并调整光源位置、颜色和亮度。

Premiere's timeline now includes options to generate video, sound effects, and soundtracks, allowing editors to fill in missing assets during the editing process. The new Color Mode is officially available, while the generative removal tool is provided as a beta version, allowing users to track unwanted objects with a mask and then have the software complete the scene. Premiere 的时间轴新增生成视频、音效和配乐等选项，编辑可在剪辑过程中补齐缺失素材。新的 Color Mode 已正式开放，生成式移除工具则以测试版提供，用户可用遮罩追踪穿帮的物体，再让软件补全画面。

item.title: Claude 推出原生表格和白板，团队可在对话里共同编辑
item.guid: Claude-推出原生表格和白板，团队可在对话里共同编辑
item.description:
Anthropic has released beta versions of Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets, and officially renamed the previous Claude Dashboards to Claude Data, transitioning it to a formal service. All three tools are available across all paid plans and support web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Anthropic 发布 Claude Whiteboards 和 Claude Sheets 测试版，并将此前的 Claude Dashboards 正式更名为 Claude Data、转为正式服务。三款工具覆盖所有付费套餐，支持网页、桌面和手机端。

Whiteboards can organize verbal discussions into timelines with assignees and dates, and also categorize team notes by topic to generate action items. Users can select a portion of the whiteboard to ask Claude questions, then convert the content into documents, slides, or transfer it to collaborative tools like Miro or Lucid for further editing. Whiteboards 可把口头讨论整理成带负责人和日期的时间线，也能将团队的便笺按主题归类、生成行动项。用户可框选白板局部向 Claude 提问，再将内容转为文档、幻灯片，或转到 Miro、Lucid 等合作工具继续编辑。

Sheets supports generating tables with multiple worksheets, formulas, formatting, and dropdown menus, marking each modification, allowing team members to collaborate on editing. Currently, it offers basic table functions; for full Excel functionality, users can export to .xlsx or CSV. Claude Data, on the other hand, adds authenticated queries, real-time sharing, caching, and version rollback, requiring connection to a data warehouse or CRM for use. Sheets 支持生成带多个工作表、公式、格式和下拉菜单的表格，并标示每次修改，团队成员可共同编辑。当前提供基础表格功能，需要完整 Excel 功能时可导出 .xlsx 或 CSV。Claude Data 则增加认证查询、实时共享、缓存和版本回退，使用时需接入数据仓库或 CRM。

The Team plan enables all three tools by default; for Enterprise, Whiteboards and Sheets are off by default, while Claude Data will be enabled by default on November 19th, with administrators able to adjust settings. Team 套餐默认开启三款工具；Enterprise 默认关闭白板和表格，Claude Data 将于 11 月 19 日默认开启，管理员可调整。

item.title: ChatGPT 开放商家认领，美国部分商家可上线客服智能体
item.guid: ChatGPT-开放商家认领，美国部分商家可上线客服智能体
item.description:
OpenAI has launched the Businesses in ChatGPT beta, allowing merchants to claim and verify their business identity through the Business Hub, and update business profiles, product prices, and inventory information. Eligible businesses in regions where ChatGPT is available can apply, and Shopify merchants can also connect their stores from the Business Hub or Shopify backend to simplify verification. OpenAI 推出 Businesses in ChatGPT 测试版，允许商家通过 Business Hub 认领并验证企业身份，更新商家资料、商品价格和库存信息。ChatGPT 已开放地区的合资格企业可以申请，Shopify 商家还可从 Business Hub 或 Shopify 后台连接店铺、简化验证。

The merchant backend provides aggregated data such as mentions, website clicks, and topics users used to discover the business. OpenAI states that these statistics require a certain conversation or interaction threshold and that user ChatGPT conversations or Business Agent chat content will not be shared with merchants. 商家后台提供被提及次数、网站点击次数及用户发现商家的话题等汇总数据。OpenAI 表示，这些统计需达到一定的会话或互动门槛，不向商家分享用户的 ChatGPT 对话或 Business Agent 聊天内容。

Once claimed, eligible e-commerce and online service businesses in the US can create, test, and launch Business Agents. When a merchant appears in a ChatGPT response, users can go to their profile page and choose to continue asking about products and services with the merchant's intelligent agent. This conversation will be clearly marked and separate from the original ChatGPT conversation. Merchants can also set the intelligent agent as a landing page for ChatGPT ads, with sponsored displays being separately labeled. 认领后，美国合资格电商和在线服务企业可创建、测试并上线 Business Agent。当商家出现在 ChatGPT 回答中，用户可以进入其资料页，选择与商家智能体继续询问产品和服务。该会话带有明确标识，并与原来的 ChatGPT 对话分开。商家也可将智能体设为 ChatGPT 广告的跳转入口，赞助展示会单独标注。

item.title: 《GTA VI》开启预载，Xbox One 发售日可通过云游戏游玩
item.guid: 《GTA-VI》开启预载，Xbox-One-发售日可通过云游戏游玩
item.description:
Rockstar announced on November 10th that pre-loading for 'GTA VI' has begun and revealed the performance targets for the console versions. The game aims for 30 frames per second on PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S, with PS5 Pro additionally supporting PSSR super-resolution and ray-traced shadows. Rockstar 于 11 月 10 日宣布《GTA VI》开启预载，并公布了主机版的运行目标。游戏在 PS5、PS5 Pro 和 Xbox Series X|S 上以 30 帧每秒为目标，PS5 Pro 额外支持 PSSR 超分辨率和光线追踪阴影。

The game will be released on November 19th. At that time, both Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S will be able to play via Xbox Cloud Gaming, with cloud streaming using Xbox Series S graphics settings. The game also supports PlayStation and Xbox remote play features. 游戏将于 11 月 19 日发售。届时 Xbox One 和 Xbox Series X/S 都可通过 Xbox Cloud Gaming 游玩，云端采用 Xbox Series S 的画质设置。游戏也支持 PlayStation 和 Xbox 的远程游玩功能。

item.title: 12 月起，帮别人买火车票也能代开电子发票
item.guid: 12-月起，帮别人买火车票也能代开电子发票
item.description:
The State Taxation Administration and China Railway Group have announced new procedures for railway electronic invoices. Starting December 1st, individuals who purchase, refund, or change tickets for others via China Railway 12306 can directly issue electronic invoices for passengers on China Railway 12306 after the journey ends or after paying refund/change fees. 国家税务总局与国铁集团公布铁路电子发票的新办理方式。12 月 1 日起，通过铁路 12306 帮他人买票、退票或改签的人，可以在行程结束或支付退票、改签费用后，直接在铁路 12306 为旅客开具电子发票。

Offline, after purchasing tickets on behalf of someone, the buyer can immediately apply for a 'scan-to-invoice slip' at the ticket counter with their own or the passenger's valid ID. When processing a refund or change on behalf of someone, the passenger's valid ID used at the time of purchase must be presented immediately. Passengers themselves can also apply for an invoice slip at the counter or self-service ticket machine with a valid ID. 在线下，代买车票后，购票人可当场凭自己或乘车人的有效身份证件到售票窗口申领「扫码开票单」。代办退票或改签时，则须当场出示乘车人购票时使用的有效身份证件。旅客本人也可凭有效身份证件在窗口或自助售票机申领开票单。

Electronic invoices will also feature a new white background style, with ticket information consistent with the original blue background version, allowing users to choose as needed. 电子发票还将新增白底样式，票面信息与原来的蓝底版一致，可按需选择。

item.title: 金鸡电影节首设 AI 单元，《无人知晓》获极客松首位推荐
item.guid: 金鸡电影节首设-AI-单元，《无人知晓》获极客松首位推荐
item.description:
The first Golden Rooster Film AI Unit announced two honorary recommendation lists in Xiamen. The 'Annual AI Work' recommendation honor from the film submission program was awarded to 'Helong,' while 'Nobody Knows' received the top recommendation in the on-site timed creation segment 'AI Hackathon'. 首届金鸡电影 AI 单元在厦门公布两份荣誉推荐名单。征片计划的「年度 AI 作品」推荐荣誉由《合龙》获得，《无人知晓》获现场限时创作环节「AI 极客松」首位推荐。

The film submission program was divided into three categories: AI-native narrative, live-action and AI integration, and AI animation, with a total of 20 works shortlisted. The Hackathon selected 20 teams from 287 applicants to complete a themed creation in Xiamen within 72 hours. Huang Minxuan, a member of the 'Tailwind' team, which received an outstanding screenplay recommendation, mentioned that AI can quickly convert hand-drawn storyboards into dynamic images, while story conception and visual effect judgment are still completed by creators. 征片计划分为 AI 原生叙事、实拍与 AI 融合、AI 动画三个方向，共有 20 部作品入围。极客松则从 287 支报名队伍中选出 20 支，在厦门用 72 小时完成命题创作。获杰出剧本推荐的「尾号等风」团队成员黄敏萱提到，AI 能较快将手绘分镜转成动态影像，构思故事和判断画面效果仍由创作者完成。

item.title: 《指环王：力量之戒》第三季 11 月 11 日开播，凯勒鹏登场
item.guid: 《指环王：力量之戒》第三季-11-月-11-日开播，凯勒鹏登场
item.description:
The third season of 'The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power' is set to premiere on Prime Video on November 11th, with four episodes released on the first day. Jamie Campbell Bower, who played Vecna in 'Stranger Things,' has joined the cast to portray Celeborn, Galadriel's long-lost husband. 《指环王：力量之戒》第三季定于 11 月 11 日在 Prime Video 开播，首日上线四集。曾在《怪奇物语》中出演维克那的杰米·坎贝尔·鲍尔加入剧组，饰演凯兰崔尔失散已久的丈夫凯勒鹏。

The new season picks up five years after the fall of Eregion, with Sauron forging the One Ring in Mordor, and Elves, Dwarves, and Men still resisting his armies. Episodes five and six will be released on November 18th, and the final two episodes are scheduled for November 25th. 新一季来到埃瑞吉安陷落五年之后，索伦正在魔多打造至尊魔戒，精灵、矮人和人类仍在各自抵抗他的军队。第五、六集将在 11 月 18 日上线，最后两集定于 11 月 25 日播出。

item.title: 华纳筹拍新版《电子情书》，《回心转意》导演接手
item.guid: 华纳筹拍新版《电子情书》，《回心转意》导演接手
item.description:
According to Variety, Warner Bros. is rebooting the 1998 romantic comedy 'You've Got Mail,' with Jason Orley, director of 'I Want You Back,' at the helm. He is currently rewriting the script based on an earlier version by Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont, with Neal Moritz and Tania Landau producing through Original Film. 据 Variety 确认，华纳兄弟正在重启 1998 年爱情喜剧《电子情书》，由《回心转意》导演 Jason Orley 执导。他正基于 Deborah Kaplan 和 Harry Elfont 的早期版本改写剧本，Neal Moritz 与 Tania Landau 将通过 Original Film 担任制片人。

The original was directed by Nora Ephron and starred Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan: the owner of a large chain bookstore and the proprietress of an independent children's bookstore are business rivals in real life but fall in love through online communication without knowing each other's identities. 原版由诺拉·艾芙蓉执导，汤姆·汉克斯与梅格·瑞恩主演：一家大型连锁书店的经营者与独立儿童书店女店主，在现实中是生意对手，却在不知对方身份的网络交流中相恋。

The story of 'You've Got Mail' originated from Miklós László's 1937 stage play, which was previously adapted into the 1940 film 'The Shop Around the Corner.' Orley previously directed 'Big Time Adolescence' and has just completed post-production on his new film 'Close Personal Friends,' starring Brie Larson, Jack Quaid, and others. 《电子情书》的故事源于米克洛什·拉斯洛 1937 年的舞台剧，此前也曾被改编为 1940 年电影《街角的商店》。Orley 曾执导《青春期》，并刚完成布丽·拉尔森、杰克·奎德等主演的新片《Close Personal Friends》的后期制作。
